Chat request with seed parameter for deterministic output; response includes system_fingerprint

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ content: "Pick a random number", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4", seed: 42 });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices[0].finishReason);
  console.log(result.systemFingerprint);
}

void main();
```
